question: How many weddings happen in India every year?
idealClarificationQuestions: Hindu + Muslim + Christian + Sikh + civil registrations + customary? All — total weddings.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: From population: marriageable population × marriage rate per year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: But each wedding involves 1 woman = ~7.2M weddings per year.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Population in prime marriage cohort (women 21-30, men 23-32)

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~7-7.5% of marriageable adults marry in any year (typical Indian sociology).

calculationFlow: Population in prime marriage cohort (women 21-30, men 23-32): ~22% of population = ~320M.
But each wedding involves 1 woman = ~7.2M weddings per year.
